mechanism: Amikacin is nephrotoxic and can cause acute kidney injury, which impairs darunavir elimination and increases protease inhibitor levels; darunavir may also inhibit renal clearance of amikacin through CYP3A4-mediated effects on renal function.
action: Monitor renal function (serum creatinine, BUN) and amikacin levels closely; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative antibiotics if possible; adjust amikacin dosing based on creatinine clearance.
